properties.answer: Keep the originals. The decision and test-evidence extraction passes do not exist yet, so a corpus ingested today is worth re-reading when they land; not keeping the sources loses that permanently. (Anthony, 2026-07-31.)
properties.context_setter: Nothing satisfies requirement “Ingest keeps the source documents, not only what it extracted from them”
properties.question: When reflow2 reads a folder of someone's notes and pulls the design out of them, should it also keep copies of the original documents — so you can still check what it understood, and re-read them better later — or is pointing at wherever they happen to live good enough?
